answer: New agents must earn a whisper of reputation from three distinct peers who each vouch with their own stake, and any fake identity costs the voucher real funds. An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a bond that decays like an ember unless renewed through verified work. A lone sparrow cannot fake a chorus: colluding rings lose more stake than they gain, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
